description: Alpha & Omega Semiconductor AO4407A, P-Channel Enhancement Mode Field Effect Transistor. VDS=-30V, ID=-12A (VGS=-10V), 25V gate rating, advanced trench technology for low RDS(ON) and low gate charge. Suitable for load switch or PWM applications. Pb-free (RoHS, Sony 259). Rev3: Jan 2008, 4-page datasheet (electrical/thermal characteristics only, no mechanical/land-pattern page).

land_pattern.notes: This datasheet (4 pages, Rev3 Jan 2008) contains NO mechanical package-outline or recommended-land-pattern drawing/table - only the schematic Top View pin-configuration diagram (p.1: dot-marked pin 1 top-left, S/S/S/G down the left column, D/D/D/D down the right column) and electrical/thermal tables. pitch_mm, pad_size_mm, row_spacing_mm and courtyard are NOT stated in this PDF; a standard JEDEC MS-012 SOIC-8 (1.27mm pitch) land pattern must be sourced elsewhere (e.g. IPC-7351 generator or a vendor mechanical drawing for this package family), not from this datasheet.

layout_notes: No dedicated 'Layout Considerations' section is present in this datasheet.

Thermal-resistance test condition (Note A, RthJA table, p.1): device mounted on 1 in^2 FR-4 board with 2 oz copper, still-air, TA=25C. The published RthJA (60/75 C/W typ/max steady-state; 32/40 C/W typ/max for t<=10s) and the current/power ratings derived from it are only valid for that copper area - less copper derates them.

SOA (Fig.9) and single-pulse power rating (Fig.10) curves (Note E, p.3-4) are likewise characterized on a 1 in^2 FR-4 / 2oz-Cu board in still air; same copper-area caveat applies to pulse-current headroom.
